title: Predict.fun Market Gives Warriors 30% Chance to Beat Nuggets
text:

 Golden State is 0-3 to open the 2026-27 NBA season. Denver entered at 1-1 after an overtime comeback win over New Orleans.
 By Enna Lee Published Oct 26, 2026, 9:27 PM EDT Save Share An unmarked basketball rests on the center circle beneath arena lights / TokenPost.ai A predict.fun market assigned the Golden State Warriors a 30% chance of beating Denver ahead of Monday night's game, as Golden State seeks its first win of the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 The Warriors have lost their first three games. Denver entered at 1-1 after overcoming a deficit of as many as 23 points to beat New Orleans in overtime.
 Golden State is scheduled to visit the Nuggets at 10 p.m. ET Monday (02:00 UTC Tuesday).
